The '''grav scoot''' was an open-air [[speeder]] that resembled a [[speeder bike]].<ref name="SWE CGSWG" /> The [[Mods|Mod gang]] used [[Mod scooter|customized grav scoots]] with intense metal flake paint jobs that made them stand out.<ref name="Databank">{{Databank|customized-grav-scoot|Customized grav scoot}}</ref>

==Description==
[[File:Grav-scoots-MandalorianS03E06.jpg||thumb|250px|left|Grav scoots on Plazir-15]]
The customized grav scoot was heavily customized with intense metal flake paint jobs that made it stand out. It was swift and sleek.<ref name="Databank" />

==History==
[[File:Customized-grav-scoot.png|thumb|250px|right|The Mods gang rode custom grav scoots with bright paint jobs.]]
Grav scoots were used by the [[Mods|Mod gang]] to [[Chase through Mos Espa|chase]] a [[Mok Shaiz's majordomo|majordomo]] in the streets of [[Mos Espa]]. [[Drash]], the leader of the Mods, used her scoot to ride over a building before landing on the [[majordomo]]'s [[Mok Shaiz's luxury speeder|landspeeder]].<ref name="Chapter 3">{{BOBF|Chapter 3: The Streets of Mos Espa}}</ref>
